Hi Lisa — great to meet you on the call earlier.

Quick answers below and next steps:

- PO issuer: Please have the PO issued to vendor-invoice@redwood-inference.com and reference Redwood vendor ID: RWI-00912. That ensures it routes to our billing queue and links to the contract.

- Required COI items: Our standard procurement needs are:
  • General liability (minimum $1M per occurrence)
  • Professional liability / E&O (min $1M) where services include engineering/consulting
  • Waiver of subrogation: not required by default
  • Additional insured: required for General Liability (endorsement CG 20 10 or equivalent)

I attached a small vendor packet with the exact endorsement language we look for and a W-9 template for convenience. If your broker can upload a COI with an "Additional Insured endorsement" and policy dates covering the initial 90 days, we can provisionally approve to allow PO issuance.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (PDF) — contains sample endorsement text and coverage matrix; W9 template (attached below)

Next steps: once you upload the COI and W-9 to the portal, reply and I'll route to Risk for a quick verification. If everything looks good, we will issue a conditional PO number and share wiring instructions.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
